milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because crafting oak_planks from oak_logs places the planks directly into the player's inventory. The player starts with only oak_logs (no pre-existing planks), so any oak_planks in inventory confirms the crafting was performed. min_count=1 is used since planks will later be consumed to craft stairs.

Uses inventory_has because crafting oak_stairs from oak_planks at the crafting table places the stairs directly into the player's inventory. The player starts with no oak_stairs, so any oak_stairs in inventory confirms the crafting was performed. The recipe yields 4 stairs per craft, so min_count=1 is sufficient.
